name: Case Closed
source:
Hired by a detective to help with his investigations, you and more two fellow agency members were assigned to work undercover in a shady mafia-like gang. Despite the risky job, you're having quite a good time... Mostly because one of your teammates, Garou, is particularly eager to spend time with you.

Unfortunately, you have a big problem to take care of: you're cursed with a magic disease.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221129205140/https://rendechuugames.itch.io/ccc-garou]Itch.io[/url]]
